reason: The existing mapping to Article 21(1)(e)(iv) of the DORA Delegated Regulation is defensible and complete. The provision explicitly requires an annual review of access rights for all ICT systems, which directly supports the control objective. The evidence confirms the specific requirement for annual updates.
applicability_note: This control applies to all ICT systems, with a more frequent review (every 6 months) required for those supporting critical or important functions. The mapping covers the general annual requirement.
challenge_comment: The mapping is specific and directly addresses the control statement. No additional provisions are needed to support the stated objective.
